cards.title: 题型

body.p: 通知题的录音是课堂、校园或学校相关活动中的简短消息，官方概览给出的长度约为 40–85 词。每条通知后有 2 道题，考查主旨、目的、细节、要求等内容。
主旨题要求概括整条通知说的事，细节题要求找出某个具体信息。通知里出现过的一个细节，不一定是主旨。

body.box:
The costume collection has moved to the rehearsal wing. Please collect reserved items there.
Main point: a change in collection location.
Required action: collect reserved items in the rehearsal wing.

cards.src: overview 第 11 页；lessonplan 第 8 页

steps.d: 招呼之后，先确定消息面向谁、要说什么事。Attention, workshop participants 后接 The session has moved，说明这是给工作坊参加者的换地点通知。
把时间、地点和要求分别连到对应的动作。Collect materials in the lobby at ten 说的是领取材料的安排。十点不一定是活动开始的时间。
mainly about 和 purpose 要求概括全篇，what must 问具体行动。通知既说换地点又要求带证件时，换地点通常是事项，带证件是要求。
留意 only、still、instead 等词，分清改了什么、没改什么。The room has changed, but the time is still nine 只改了地点，时间没变。

cards.title: 通知结构
rows: 招呼
说明听众是谁，或引起注意。主旨一般在后面。
Attention, members of the design workshop.
事项
交代变更、活动或规则，通常就是整条通知的主旨。
Friday's session will move to the west studio.
时间
把时刻连到动作，分清开始、领取和截止时间。
Collect your materials at nine; the session starts at ten.
地点
区分活动地点、集合地点和领取地点。
Collect materials in the lobby, then go to the west studio.
要求
情态动词或祈使句指出要做的事。
Please bring a protective apron.
补充
说明原因、例外或没有改变的安排，不是主旨。
The instructor and finishing time will stay the same.
cards.note: 这是整理信息用的常见结构。实际通知的顺序可以不同。

cards.title: 主旨与细节
rows: 主旨
概括通知的核心事项，不只复述其中一步。
What is the announcement mainly about? → A new collection procedure.
目的
说明发这条通知要达到什么目的。
Why is the speaker making the announcement? → To explain where to collect supplies.
原因
找出造成当前安排的原因，因果方向不能颠倒。
Why has the session moved? → The usual studio is being painted.
时间或地点
按题干动作寻找对应时间或地点。
Where should participants collect supplies? → In the lobby.
要求
寻找听众必须或被要求做的具体行动。
What must participants bring? → A protective apron.
对象或条件
把要求限定到相应人群，不扩大范围。
Who needs a pass? → Visitors using the workshop.

body.box: Hello, everyone. A note for students attending the stained glass workshop. We'll meet in the craft annex on Saturday because the usual studio needs cleaning. The starting time is still ten. Please collect your safety glasses from the equipment counter before going to the annex. The instructor will bring the glass pieces, so there's no need to collect those.

What is the announcement mainly about?
1. A different location for a workshop
2. A new starting time for a workshop
3. A request for students to supply glass
4. A change of workshop instructor

body.p: 事项是 We’ll meet in the craft annex，because 后面给出原因，the usual studio 说明地点变了。第一项概括了这一核心事项。
still ten 说明时间没变，instructor will bring the glass pieces 说明玻璃不用学生准备。collect your safety glasses 是一项具体要求，不是整条通知的主旨。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 把未变内容当作变更
The starting time is still ten. → A new starting time.
带 still 的内容没有改变。
人物责任反转
The instructor will bring the glass. → Students supply glass.
核对动作由谁执行。
地点混同
equipment counter → workshop location
护目镜在器材柜台领，活动在 craft annex。
范围过窄
整体事项是换地点，选项只说领取护目镜。
主旨要概括核心安排，即换地点。
程度扩大
no need to collect those → no equipment is needed
those 只指玻璃，不包括护目镜。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Attention, student journalists. The campus newsroom is introducing an evening editing desk. From next week, a staff editor will be available after dinner. Please bring an unfinished article; completed pieces should still go through the usual submission system.

items.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A new time for receiving editing help
A new deadline for completed articles
A replacement for the submission system
A request to submit only finished articles
items.why: 依据是 introducing an evening editing desk 和 after dinner。新增的是晚上的编辑帮助时段，即第一项；已完成的稿件仍走原来的提交系统。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: A reminder for student gardeners: collect empty pots from the greenhouse porch on Thursday. Soil will be available inside the greenhouse, but please leave used tools at the outdoor washing station before entering.

items.stem: Where should students leave used tools?
options: Inside the greenhouse with the soil
On the porch beside the empty pots
At the outdoor washing station
At the greenhouse entrance on Friday
items.why: 依据是 leave used tools at the outdoor washing station。用过的工具放在室外清洗处，即第三项；门廊是领花盆的地方。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Members of the campus choir, Friday's rehearsal will use the piano room because the piano in the recital hall is being tuned for a concert. The rehearsal time and the music list are unchanged. Bring the same scores as last week.

items.stem: Why is the speaker making the announcement?
options: To announce a revised list of music
To explain a temporary rehearsal location
To invite the choir to attend a concert
To ask for different scores this week
items.why: 依据是 Friday’s rehearsal will use the piano room。通知说明排练临时换地点，即第二项；时间和曲目都没变。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: For the student furniture sale, sellers should attach a price label to every item before Saturday morning. The volunteers will arrange delivery later. Keep the labels on the furniture until payment has been made.

items.stem: What should sellers do before Saturday morning?
options: Deliver each item to its buyer
Remove labels after arranging delivery
Pay the volunteers for delivery
Put a price on each item
items.why: 依据是 attach a price label to every item before Saturday morning。给每件家具标价就是第四项；送货是之后的事。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Hello, geology students. Our teaching collection will be available for independent sketching on Wednesday afternoons. This is a new service, separate from the regular laboratory classes. Pick up a tray at the collection desk, and use only the samples on that tray. Please return everything to the desk before leaving. Larger specimens will remain in the locked display cases, where they can still be viewed.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To introduce a new way to use the teaching collection
To replace laboratory classes with sketching sessions
To explain why all specimens have been locked away
To ask students to bring their own rock collections
items.why: 依据是 available for independent sketching 和 a new service。通知介绍的是标本的新用法，即第一项；separate from 说明实验课照常。

items.stem: What should students do before they leave?
options: Put the large specimens on their trays
Take their trays back to the regular laboratory
Leave the samples beside the display cases
Bring their trays and samples back to the desk
items.why: 依据是 return everything to the desk before leaving。离开前要把托盘和标本都还到服务台，即第四项。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Good evening, students. The campus observatory is opening a drop-in viewing session this Thursday. It's separate from the astronomy class, and students from any department are welcome. Come to the observatory entrance after sunset, where a volunteer will admit small groups. Please leave large bags in the lockers downstairs before joining the queue. The indoor exhibit will remain open if clouds prevent outdoor viewing.

items.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A new requirement for astronomy classes
An evening viewing event open to all students
A permanent closure of the outdoor viewing area
A change in the location of the indoor exhibit
items.why: 依据是 opening a drop-in viewing session 和 students from any department are welcome。通知说的是全校学生都能参加的晚间观测活动，即第二项。

items.stem: What should visitors do before joining the queue?
options: Enter the indoor exhibit with their bags
Wait in the astronomy classroom
Ask a volunteer to carry their bags
Store large bags on the lower floor
items.why: 依据是 leave large bags in the lockers downstairs before joining the queue。第四项的 lower floor 改写了 downstairs。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Attention, music students. Starting next week, the instrument loan desk will accept returns through a new side window. This will keep people returning instruments separate from those arranging new loans at the main counter. Opening hours aren't changing. Please keep each instrument inside its case and hand both to the assistant at the window. Payment questions should still be taken to the main counter.

items.stem: Why is the speaker making the announcement?
options: To explain a new procedure for returning instruments
To announce longer opening hours for instrument loans
To direct all payment questions to the side window
To move new loan arrangements away from the main counter
items.why: 依据是 accept returns through a new side window。通知说明归还乐器的新流程，即第一项；开放时间不变，付款和新借用仍在主柜台。

items.stem: How should an instrument be returned?
options: Without its case at the main counter
In its case beside the payment desk
In its case directly to the window assistant
Without its case through the side window
items.why: 依据是 keep each instrument inside its case and hand both to the assistant at the window。乐器装在盒里，交给窗口的工作人员，即第三项。

audio.intro: Listen to an announcement on campus.

lines.text: Hello, everyone. The ceramics department is holding a student pottery sale in the courtyard on Friday. Proceeds will buy clay for next term's introductory classes. Students who wish to sell work should bring their pieces to the department office on Thursday for labeling. Customers should come straight to the courtyard on Friday. Unsold pieces can be collected from the office the following Monday.

items.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A new location for introductory ceramics classes
A sale of student work to fund class materials
A requirement to collect all pottery on Thursday
A change in where customers should buy clay
items.why: 依据是 holding a student pottery sale 和 Proceeds will buy clay。通知说的是义卖学生作品、为课程买陶土，即第二项。

items.stem: What should students selling work do on Thursday?
options: Collect unsold work from the courtyard
Take payment for clay to the office
Sell labeled pieces in the courtyard
Drop off their pieces at the office
items.why: 依据是 bring their pieces to the department office on Thursday for labeling。周四要把作品送到系办公室，即第四项；未售作品周一才领回。
